page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, with page number at left and chapter marker at right. Main text in one column, right of centre. Two marginal notes in the left margin, one beside the first paragraph and one beside the start of SECT. V. A heading centred between the text paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: respondere Mercedem, sed sicut certum quoddam donum ex Congruo: ità Mercedem quandam dicimus esse ex Congruo, quæ magìs debeatur ex Gratia, quàm ex justitia. Quæ confessio tua vestrum pro Merito de Condigno Argumentum planè jugulat, siquidem Theologis vestris fidem ullam habeamus; de quibus Costerus Jesuita, {s} Catholici (inquit) Meritum hoc modo definiunt, ut sit Actio cui merces debetur ex Justitia. De Mercede distinguimus. Alia est Merces Æqualitatis & Commensurationis, seu Condignitatis ad opus: & sic Merces & Meritum correlativa sunt. Sed alia est Merces Munificentia & Benignitatis, quæ Dignitatem Operis infinitis modis excedit. Sed de hoc multò opportunior erit differendi locus in capitibus sequentibus De Mercede; ubi nihil nos de Mercede statuere quivis intelligat, quod non erat à Catholicis Patribus antiquitus decretum & definitum.Coster. Enchirid. Tract. de Meritis, cap.7.
main_text.head: III. Clasis Scripturarum objicitur pro Merito de Condigno.
main_text.p: {h}Aliæ sunt loca (inquit Cardinalis) in quibus vita dicitur reddi secundum mensuram. Luc.6. Quà mensurà mensi fueritis, eadem remetietur vobis. Loquitur tam de bonis quàm malis. Et, Reddet unicuique secundum opera,Bellarm. lib.5. de Iu-stif. cap.3.

page.notes: Running head is ANTIDOTVM, with "Cap.2." at top right (chapter marker, not part of the running head). Page number 18 at top left, read with some doubt. Tract. de Meritis, cap.7." and "Bellarm. lib.5. de Iu-stif. cap.3." Italic extent in the first paragraph is approximate. The catchword "malis" is printed at lower right, after a dash line under the last text line.
